# dnhsrocketry-webapp

Scaffolded Vite + React app to port the DNHS Rocketry site into React/Tailwind.

Quick start:

1. cd webapp
2. npm install
3. npm run dev

Notes:
- This is a minimal scaffold. To complete shadcn/ui integration, run the shadcn setup steps (Tailwind + shadcn CLI) and add desired components.
- The `CADViewer` currently embeds a Stellar Canvas iframe as a fallback. I can add a Three.js OBJ/STL renderer next.
